project_name: Sistem Informasi Pemantauan Stock Opname Logistik (SIPOSTLOG)

theme_strategy.rule: Preserve existing light civic aesthetic. Use crisp white cards, slate borders, deep navy headers, and orange active accents. Avoid dark backgrounds.

hierarchy.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

login_form_requirements: Ensure username 'admin' and password 'admin' authenticates successfully.
Input field for password MUST use type='password'.

routes_and_navigation.label: Kelola Barang
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Tambah barang baru, edit rincian barang, dan hapus barang dari inventaris.

routes_and_navigation.label: Berita Acara Penyaluran
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Pembuatan dan cetak dokumen resmi Berita Acara Penyaluran Logistik secara otomatis dengan penomoran unik.

routes_and_navigation.label: Stock Opname AI
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Upload file Excel stock opname dengan pemetaan kolom AI (AI header mapping), pratinjau data, dan konfirmasi pembaruan otomatis.

routes_and_navigation.label: Kelola Pengguna
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Tambah dan atur akun pengguna berdasarkan tugas (Admin, Petugas Gudang, Tim Stock Opname).

routes_and_navigation.label: Catat Barang Masuk
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Pencatatan manual transaksi barang masuk oleh Petugas Gudang.

routes_and_navigation.label: Catat Penyaluran
routes_and_navigation.purpose: Pencatatan manual penyaluran logistik bencana oleh Petugas Gudang.

features: Form input for recipient (penerima), location (lokasi bencana), disaster event (kejadian bencana), and distribution date
Multi-item table selector with quantity input
Printable formatted view (A4 layout print preview / PDF generate)
Drag & drop or file selector for Excel (.xlsx, .xls)
AI column detection header mapping preview (Kode Barang, Nama Barang, Stok Fisik, Kondisi, Catatan)
Diff preview confirmation dialog showing changes (Old stock vs New AI mapped stock)
Commit stock opname update action button
Form create user (Username, Nama Lengkap, Password, Peran/Role)
List of existing users with role badges
Reset password or delete user trigger

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FIX LOGIN BUG: Ensure admin backend login recognizes username 'admin' with password 'admin'. Fix any auth hash or query mismatch.
2. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT (/app/barang): Create full CRUD page to add, edit, search, and delete logistik items (Penambahan & Penghapusan Barang).
3. AUTOMATED BERITA ACARA (/app/berita-acara): Build automated Berita Acara Penyaluran generator with auto-numbering, multi-item table selection, and print-ready document view.
4. AI EXCEL STOCK OPNAME (/app/impor-ai): Create Excel upload flow where backend/AI parses column headers, renders preview mapping confirmation, and updates stock opname upon user confirmation.
5. USER CREATION BY ROLE (/app/pengguna): Allow admin to create local accounts with roles: admin, petugas_gudang, and tim_stock_opname.
6. WAREHOUSE MANUAL TASKS: Keep and enhance manual forms for barang masuk (/app/barang-masuk) and penyaluran (/app/catat-penyaluran).
7. DATA-TESTID STRICTNESS: Every form field, button, table row, and modal must include specific role-based data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
Maintain contrast accessibility standards. Hover states must explicitly set text color.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header, overlays, or dropdown menus.
Never show plain passwords on screen; always use input type='password'.
Ensure standard light mode responsive grid layout with minimum internal padding p-4 or p-6.
